notes: IRS Notice 2025-67 (2026 limits). Only 2026 is tabulated; other years use the nearest tabulated year, so add a year row each autumn. 60-63 super catch-up (SECURE 2.0 sec. 109) replaces, not adds to, the age-50 catch-up. Roth IRA phase-out reduction is rounded up to the next $10 with a $200 floor while any reduction applies (IRS Pub 590-A). The Roth catch-up wage test applies to prior-year FICA wages above the threshold.
